description: VarsaAI checks a passage sentence by sentence and returns a citation for each claim, drawing on PubMed, openFDA and the team's own approved reference library. Users can verify draft copy, pull up an earlier verification as a report, search saved references, export an MLR-ready package for review, and share a read-only link to a completed verification.
